articles.title: First Thing: Court files show how federal agents spied on anti-ICE protesters | Martin Belam
articles.description:

articles.title: Victims of road crime feel ‘forgotten by system’, official review finds
articles.description:
Many of those affected in England and Wales think offences are not treated with the seriousness they deserve, says commissioner

Bereaved families or seriously injured victims of road crime feel “forgotten by the system” with offences not treated with the seriousness they deserve, an official review has found.

The victims’ commissioner for England and Wales found that many of the thousands afflicted each year by criminal driving felt that “the harm they had suffered mattered less” than that from other serious crimes.

articles.title: Honk if your barn is burning: pet goose alerts sleeping Texas family to blaze
articles.description:
Family ‘extremely grateful’ to four-month-old ‘Goosey’ who ran out of fire-billowing building and repeatedly squawked

A pet goose is being credited with helping save a Texas family’s animals after sounding a honking alarm as a fire tore through their barn.

The dramatic moment unfolded on the morning of 4 August in Fort Bend county, where four-month-old Goosey repeatedly squawked outside the burning barn, alerting his owners, the Gerber family, to the danger.
